Custom Tag Resource Get All Custom Tags
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/customTags

Gets the list of custom tags available to assign to cloud applications

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32
